about_the_game: Graffism VR is immersive painting simulator lets you create art on any surface within your reach giving you room to express yourself like never before. Use a variety of tools: spray cans, markers and even fire extinguishers. Paint across richly detailed urban locations or visit the paint shop to decorate individual objects in your own style. Customize your avatar with a wide selection of clothes and accessories. It’s your creative freedom in VR.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR, Quest3, Quest2, QuestPro, Oculus Rift S, Valve Index
